competitorNotes: Aquarius trait-and-date posters are common, usually as printables pitched at 'January and February birthdays'; framed versions show roughly $25-43 in snippets.
January 20 - February 18, the range printed here, is the most common one in results; trait words vary by seller.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
Aquarius prints on Amazon are 8x10 or 11x14 'unframed' traits, watercolor constellation, and water-bearer designs.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'aquarius zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
